coverage.claim: Quartic Allen–Cahn and Cahn–Hilliard no-flux gradient-flow models, finite-energy class, and dimension restrictions for quartic growth.
No-flux TPFA graph realization and conforming interval realization with stated mass, stiffness, potential split, and sign convention.
Finite-dimensional Neumann operator symmetry, kernel, range, mean-zero inverse and mesh-dependent Poincare inequality.
Exact-mass interval projector stability and approximation, including strong H1 convergence for every H1 test.
Separately defined stabilized semi-implicit variant with no imported energy, solvability, maximum-principle, or error claim.
First-order SAV Cahn–Hilliard system with independent auxiliary variable.
Backward-Euler convex-splitting minimizations for AC and CH.
Unique SAV solve, mass conservation and exact modified-energy identity.
Unique convex-splitting step minimizers, Euler equations, CH mass conservation and physical discrete-energy decay.
First-order fixed-mesh time errors under smooth semidiscrete trajectories, with constants depending on h, epsilon and T.
One-dimensional fixed-epsilon subsequential mesh/time convergence for the conforming interval realization to weak no-flux AC and CH solutions.
No higher-dimensional finite-volume convergence, sharp-interface limit, maximum-principle transfer, or physical-energy conclusion from SAV modified-energy decay.
coverage.detail: These exclusions are stated in the relevant definitions, theorem statements, and item remarks.
